articles.title: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
articles.excerpt: We study length inflation in on-policy distillation (OPD), where student responses can become excessively long and even exhaust the generation budget. articles.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
articles.excerpt: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the sci
articles.summary: 针对科学代码库工具链碎片化、领域约定隐式、正确性标准特殊，难以转化为可靠学习经验的问题，提出 ScienceIDE，将全球科学代码仓库转为 Agent 可学习的环境。通过把可执行模型与方法封装为交互式任务环境，使编码 Agent 能在真实科学计算场景中训练与评估。

articles.title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness

articles.summary: 面向编码 Agent 从监督补全走向无人值守长时探索的趋势，SoL-Pi 关注递归自我改进中的 token 效率。该方法递归扩展自动研究循环，构建高效的 Agent harness，使推理、工具调用与反馈构成的长轨迹在有限 token 预算下持续迭代，提升自研究循环的可扩展性。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents

articles.summary: 现有工作多把编码 harness 当作整体系统评估，难以判断各组件对长程软件工程表现的实际贡献。本文开展 harness 设计的实证研究，支持组件级对比，系统分析不同设计选择如何影响自主编码 Agent 将模型能力转化为长程任务性能，为 harness 设计提供可复用经验。

articles.title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents

articles.summary: 可靠置信度估计对语言模型的可信部署至关重要，但现有估计器共享同一设计前提。本文提出「经验置信度」估计，主张置信度应来自经验而非单一输出分布。方法覆盖从推理到 Agent 的场景，借助历史经验校准输出正确的概率，支持发布、升级与重试等决策。

articles.title: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks
articles.excerpt: Coding agents are typically evaluated with desired behavior specified through issues or instructions. articles.summary: 现实 Web 开发中，编码 Agent 常需从可运行软件反推行为并在不完整应用中实现它。为此提出 ProgramDistill 基准，把交互式 Web 应用转化为可验证、参考引导的 SWE 任务，要求 Agent 依据已有程序推断目标行为并完成实现，使评测更贴近真实工程场景。

articles.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
articles.excerpt: Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended. articles.title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
articles.excerpt: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. articles.summary: 世界模型能帮助智能体预测后果并指导干预，但现有预测模型多局限单一领域。本文提出 JEPA-Anything，一个领域无关的预测建模框架，探索能否用统一学习原则跨越差异极大的系统构建世界模型，从而将 JEPA 式预测学习推广到多种世界与模态。

articles.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants

articles.title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
articles.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment.
